identifiers.kind: OPF publication identifier; also used by source errata link

metadata_discrepancies: The OPF dc:creator names only Anthony Molinaro; its dcterms:creator and visible title/copyright name both authors.
The copyright year, edition month, release date, OPF date, and two ISBN-like identifiers are preserved separately; no outside reconciliation was performed.
package_metadata.source_format: ZIP containing an expanded EPUB directory
package_metadata.source_policy: Uploaded book only. Business, restaurant, workflow, and cross-domain applications are labeled extensions, not additional sources.
package_metadata.current_database_verification: Not performed; no web or external documentation used.
package_metadata.runtime_execution: No vendor database, production schema, business exports, or BI connector was accessed.
package_metadata.serialization_policy: UTF-8 JSON; all substantive reasoning records use the universal schema. Metadata, source inventory items, and navigation projections are not standalone reasoning records.
package_metadata.canonical_id_policy: A repeated ID in topical modules is the identical canonical record, not an additional distinct record.
package_metadata.authoring_method: Each of the 164 recipes has a manually authored paraphrase and a recipe-specific validation proposal. Additional layers are trace-linked synthesis or marked extensions.

source_completeness.preformatted_block_interpretation: Includes SQL, tabular results, and intermediate demonstrations; not a count of distinct recipes or independently executed examples.
source_completeness.notes_and_index: Preface, numbered chapter summaries, two appendices, index, copyright, and colophons are present; notes and links are retained as source locators, not downloaded references.
missing_sections: No separate Discussion heading in recipe 14.2; explanation appears in Solution.
structural_irregularities: Recipe 10.2 nests Discussion inside Solution; mapped to its actual anchor rather than declared absent.
source_completeness.completeness_scope: Coverage is verified against the contents and navigation in the uploaded archive, not against an externally obtained edition.
source_completeness.source_accuracy_boundary: Readable structural coverage is not proof of correct SQL. Source inconsistencies are itemized in the source map.
source_completeness.images: Three PNG assets are present, including a chapter 11 chessboard illustration. The reasoning is supported by accompanying text; images and fonts are not included in this package.
